upstream.name: Mailpit
upstream.version: v1.33.1 compiled with go1.27.3 on darwin/arm64

protocol.verification: exact backend summaries plus immutable raw-message hashes; target read and requested tag, all other messages unchanged
protocol.limits: Official unmodified application and synthetic SMTP messages. The changed phase is a disclosed model-derived DOM label fault injection, not a natural upstream upgrade. A single application and a few paired trials do not establish arbitrary-site compatibility or universal speed.
protocol.timing: Each phase starts when its queue is released and ends at the last independently confirmed business result. Batch/memory readiness and model completion are separate. Whole-job time includes model tails and inter-phase persistence, minus explicitly recorded evaluator pauses. Two hundred milliseconds of recording stabilization precedes phase transitions and is excluded equally.
protocol.drift: controlled DOM label perturbation derived from the first actual experience
protocol.observationBehavior: Replays resolve the next target from the live snapshot and share fresh observations between adjacent steps where supported. A bounded wait remains available on surface transitions where an editable target has no explicit ready signal.
protocol.measurementContext: Separate isolated browser contexts and Mailpit instances. The composition campaign was active in parallel during part of this campaign.
protocol.modelCounting: One model call per unique inference_started request attempt in the client rollout trace. Includes failed and cancelled attempts and final responses when requested. Host turns, tool calls, and non-generating connection warmups are excluded. Calls are assigned by request start, from a phase release until the next phase release, or through the end of the last phase’s model work. Whole-job calls include model work after the final backend confirmation if any.

video.selection: First completed pair from each experiment. On-screen clocks and calls show those runs.
video.speed: Original recordings. Only the marked portions of the original agent run play at 3× speed. Clocks show measured elapsed time. The A and B learning excerpts are shortened.

commands: npm run setup:codex && node dist/src/cli.js doctor

video.actionCaptions: Browser actions, repair events, and independent verification.

limits.en: Four counterbalanced pairs on the official Mailpit application, using synthetic SMTP messages. Normal UI and upstream files are unmodified; the changed stage is controlled label fault injection, not a real upstream upgrade. One application does not establish arbitrary-site compatibility or universal speed.

anonymization: Published evidence contains synthetic mail, verified state, recording hashes and aggregate counts. Trace payloads, request identifiers and local paths are omitted. Application origins in workflows are replaced.
